title: Carrier Recalls Carrier- and Bryant-Branded Heat Pumps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fan motor on the heat pumps can fail, causing the units to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,350 (in addition, about 450 were sold in Canada).

title: IKEA Recalls Infant Bibs Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snap on the bibs can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,000.

title: Kawasaki Motors USA Recalls Lawn Mower Engines Due to Burn and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel injector can leak excessive amounts of fuel into the engine, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 950.

title: Ronson Brand Tech Torch Recalled by Zippo Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The Ronson Tech Torch can continue to produce a flame after the activation trigger is released into the off position, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 660,000 (in addition, approximately 98,000 were distributed in Canada).

title: Fit For Life Recalls SPRI Ultra Heavy Resistance Bands Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The rubber resistance bands can separate from the handle and strike consumers, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 95,000.

title: fluidfreeride Recalls Mercane WideWheel Electric Scooters Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The brake caliper can fail causing the rider to lose control and suffer serious bodily harm, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 1,800 (In addition, about 66 were sold in Canada).

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls Gordon Folding Knives Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The locking mechanism can fail to engage on extension of the blade, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 1.1 million.

title: E&E Recalls Bedroom Dressers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. The dressers do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM 2057-17). Units: About

title: Ridgewood Recalls Four-Drawer Dressers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Kmart
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable and can tip over if not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. title: Signature Hardware Recalls Bath Stools Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The bath stools can break during use, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 200 (In addition, 4 were sold in Canada).

title: VIQUA Recalls Solenoid Valve Kits for UV Water Treatment Systems Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: Electrical current could leak from the solenoid valve, posing an electrical shock hazard to the user. Units: About 70 (in addition, about 170 were sold in Canada).

title: Federal Cartridge Recalls Blackhawk Gun Holsters Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The holster design can change the position of the safety switch on the firearm without the user knowing it. When this occurs, if the trigger is pulled the gun could fire unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard to the user and bystander. Units: About 3,100.

title: Soft Play Recalls Spider Climb Playground Climbers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The climbing level platforms were designed too far apart, posing a fall hazard to children who can fall climbing from one level to the next. Units: About 200.

title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Tractors Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Front cab support bolts that were torqued improperly during manufacturing can fail during a rollover, posing a crushing injury hazard to the operator. Units: About 5,700 (In addition, about 1,650 were sold in Canada).

title: New Port Sales Recalls All-Gloo Craft Glue Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirements; Poison Hazard to Children
summary: The glue contains methanol and poses a poisoning hazard to young children if ingested. The packaging is not child-resistant as required by the Poisoning Prevention Packaging Act. Units: About 46,000.

title: Kawasaki Motors USA Recalls Lawn Mower Engines Due to Burn and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The high pressure fuel line can get damaged causing a fuel leak, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 1,100.

title: Hit Promotional Products Recalls Ceramic Mugs Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The mugs can crack or break when used with or exposed to hot liquids, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 34,000.

title: Michaels Recalls Tassel Keychain Mobile Power Banks Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium ion battery in the keychain's mobile power bank can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 14,000 (In addition, about 950 in Canada).
